text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—Haa... haa...! I'll win...! I'll win, 
win, win...—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Hold on tight...! Don't let them pass 
you, faster, faster... endlessly—)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: The strongest is me...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ghaaaaaaa...hh!!

The cheers from the crowd grew louder 
along with Duramente's acceleration. But 
if she kept going like that, she would...—

“—She screamed. Amidst the roaring cheers, 
with all her heart and soul.”

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ――...Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
This year's Satsuki Sho was a fierce 
battle! The one who claimed the glorious 
first crown is—
(Uwoooooah...!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Dammit...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Duramente~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The result was unfortunate, but still! 
That was an amazing run!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"You were amazing...! But your best 
running is surely yet to come!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
—Proof of the strongest bloodline! Show it 
to us in the Nippon Derby!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Next time—next time for sure, I'll show 
them...!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hyaa~... That was terrifying!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Hm, the girl who won?

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Not that! It's Duramente-san! 
Duramente-san!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"What was with that running?! It was way 
too scary...! I totally thought she was 
the one who won!"

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I know... She looks fired up even now. The 
Japan Derby—she might be seriously insane.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So that is Duramente-san's 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
OK, I admit it. My spine shivered too... 
but this is a shiver of excitement before 
battle.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"If she's going to become stronger than 
anyone else next time, then I'll aim even 
higher."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm raring to go! Come on, let's 
devise a strategy! ...I won't let anyone 
take the Nippon Derby!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Incredible, Dura-san.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Captivating everyone's hearts through 
sheer power... There's that kind of 
strength, too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Pheeew... So cool!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...I gotta give it my all too! Alright, 
time to train!"

Duramente gave a breathtaking performance. 
Though she suffered defeat, she showed a 
glimpse of what lies ahead on her path—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Y-Your... voice. Isn't it completely 
hoarse?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Your voice definitely reached me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I may have lost, but at the very end... I 
was able to run a race I'm satisfied with.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Why you, too?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I'm not following.
choice_data_list:
What got through was your feelings, I'm 
sure.

text_block_list.text:
In truth, just as Duramente had doubted, 
it is difficult for a single voice to 
pierce through the roaring cheers of 
50,000 spectators and the thunder of the 
race itself.

So if she heard a voice... it's thanks to 
her believing it would reach, holding 
those feelings in her heart.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I see, I'm...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You believed that... they would make their 
voice heard, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Taking today's reflections into 
account, I want to come up with a new 
menu."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Defeat is no longer an option. ...Next 
time, I will win.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Will you come with me?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'll go change.

By speaking to Duramente, she was able to 
turn her awareness outward. However, there 
was no telling how long that would remain 
effective.
choice_data_list:
(I need to think of a more fundamental 
solution—)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Just a little more.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer's voice opened the door for me. 
But in the end, I'm the one who has to 
change.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(I can't run an overwhelming, perfect race 
like this. Before the next one—)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Before that race... the one I've yearned 
and longed for...!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
By the time the Nippon Derby arrives— I 
will secure a flawless victory, without 
fail...!
